scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @portfolio/web && npm run build -w @portfolio/api
scripts.test:db: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U portfolio -d portfolio -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'portfolio_test'" | grep -q 1 || docker compose exec -T postgres createdb -U portfolio portfolio_test; TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://portfolio:portfolio@localhost:54329/portfolio_test vitest run apps/api/src/store
